preview_tabs.markdownDescription:
Switch to the highlighted tab while the quick panel is open.

When `false`, the tab only changes once the switch is committed.

keystate_helper_path.markdownDescription:
Path to the `tabstack-keystate` helper that detects Ctrl releases on Linux.

It is used whenever it works, and it is required under native Wayland.

keystate_ctrl_keys.markdownDescription:
The keys the `tabstack-keystate` helper treats as Ctrl, for keyboard layouts that remap Ctrl, e.g. `["leftctrl", "rightctrl", "capslock"]` for the XKB option `ctrl:nocaps`.

Only modifier keys are allowed, so that the helper cannot be used to log keystrokes.

show_wayland_setup_dialog.markdownDescription:
Offer the helper's setup instructions on the first `ctrl+tab` per plugin load when Ctrl-release detection is unavailable under native Wayland.

The dialog's "Don't Ask Again" button sets this to `false`.
